name: Shako
description: Real cloud VMs that are interconnected, SSH-able, created in seconds, auto-sleep to save, and wake up in milliseconds. Typical use cases: remote coding (a Conductor alternative), small software hosting, agent hosting. New users get $5 credit (~1 month of a 4 GB RAM / 32 GB disk VM). The plugin installs a panel UI and skills to operate your fleet. VMs are added to Orca's SSH Hosts automatically, ready to connect. Support: https://discord.gg/Q93fEaF3A
